card.title: Nintendo Wii System cant connect to wifi

source.title: Nintendo Wii System cant connect to wifi

claims.statement: Wii Wi-Fi failure: check antennas; a dead Wi-Fi chip gives a black screen instead, so board replacement is rarely the fix; RVLoader Wi-Fi patches can be removed by reinstalling IOS36/58/80.

procedure: Reinstall default IOS if RVLoader was used.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
